subject: Upgrade request: increase hosted API commit + rate-limit adjustment
messages:
From: Eli Navarro <eli@brightcart.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightcart.com
Date: 2027-05-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request to increase monthly commit and adjust rate limits

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the call yesterday. We ran the load tests against the current hosted plan and expect production traffic to rise quickly once the new recommendation engine ships. Can you confirm options for increasing our monthly commit from 2,000,000 tokens to ~8,000,000 tokens and whether we can get a higher per-route rate limit during the rollout window?

Key asks:
- Monthly committed tokens: 8M vs current 2M
- Rate limits: aiming for 300 requests/min per route (currently capped at 120)
- Billing: prorated for the month of upgrade if we sign mid-cycle
- SLA: minimum latency threshold for inference (p50 < 110ms)

Wed like to move quickly — legal is on standby once pricing and a short MSA amendment are confirmed.

Thanks,
Eli Navarro
Head of Platform
BrightCart

--
Attachment: BrightCart_MA_MVP_Proposal.pdf (proposal / traffic forecasts)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Eli Navarro <eli@brightcart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to increase monthly commit and adjust rate limits

Eli —

Appreciate the details and the projection doc. Short answers up front: yes, we can provision an 8M token monthly commit and lift per-route burst capacity for the rollout; well do this as a staged activation to avoid noisy neighbor effects.

Proposed path (high level):
1) Commercial: add a one-line amendment to your MSA for the new committed quantity and a quarterly invoice schedule (we can prorate for May).
2) Ops: we provision a staged throughput lane and temporarily increase per-route rate limits to 300 req/min for a 72-hour ramp window; after that we apply the agreed steady-state limits (200 req/min) unless you opt for a permanent rate increase.
3) Observability: we'll set up a shared Redwood Console dashboard with token-level cost and latency panels and an alert for p50/p95 regressions.
4) Legal/procurement: we can route a DocuSign amendment and accept a PO.

I'll loop in Ben for pricing and Karthik for the rollout plan. If youre good, we can target a sign-by date of 2027-05-26 and activate the first tranche 48 hours after DocuSign completes.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0137

--
Attachments: RBW_DocuSign_BRG-4721.pdf (placeholder for amendment)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Eli Navarro <eli@brightcart.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T14:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to increase monthly commit and adjust rate limits

Eli / team —

Pricing options for BRG-4721:
- Option A (annual prepay): 8M tokens/month, annual prepay with 8% discount to list.
- Option B (12-month commit, monthly invoice): 8M tokens/month, 4% discount, monthly billing.
- Option C (staged uplift): start at 5M tokens/month for two months (to reduce proration impact), then move to 8M; we can apply a one-time onboarding credit of $2,000 for operational costs.

For the rate limits: we can enable a temporary 300 req/min per route for a 72h window during the activation; steady-state cap weve proposed is 200 req/min unless you want larger reserved capacity (that requires Dedicated or a higher commit band).

Action items for procurement:
- Choose pricing option A/B/C
- Send PO or confirm DocuSign signature path

Ill draft the amendment language and attach a final appendix for billing cadence.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: RBW_DocuSign_BRG-4721.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Eli Navarro <eli@brightcart.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-23T08:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to increase monthly commit and adjust rate limits

Eli — quick ops note from engineering/solutions: 

Well provision a dedicated throughput lane scoped to BrightCart for the staged rollout. Implementation details:
- Activation window: 48-72 hours after DocuSign completes.
- Ramp plan: 0% -> 40% -> 75% -> 100% of provisioned throughput in ~18-hour increments, with health checks after each step.
- Rate limits: temporary 300 req/min per route during ramp; steady-state 200 req/min unless you purchase the higher steady band.
- KV cache and prefix caching: we recommend enabling prefix caching for your recommendation calls to reduce token volume and keep steady-state costs down (we can share a one-page config).
- Fallback: if p95 latency increases >20% vs baseline, automated fallback pushes traffic to a compatible quantized model (same API surface) to preserve latency SLOs.

Well need an ops kickoff (30m) after signature to confirm routes, keys, and the dashboard scope.

—Karthik
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Eli Navarro <eli@brightcart.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightcart.com, contracts@brightcart.com, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-24T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to increase monthly commit and adjust rate limits

Tessa / Ben —

Thanks — were aligned on Option B (12-month commit, monthly invoice) with the 4% discount. Procurement will raise a PO this afternoon; contracts will sign the DocuSign amendment and route it back to you.

Couple of clarifications before sign:
- Proration: please confirm the billing proration mechanics if we sign on 2027-05-26 (will the May invoice reflect the partial-month usage at the new commit rate?).
- Activation SLA: can you add a one-line note to the amendment that well start the staged activation within 48 hours of DocuSign completion (subject to keys/ops kickoff)?

If you confirm both items well push the PO and sign. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Eli

--
Proposed next steps: 1) Tessa to confirm proration language and DocuSign will be sent today; 2) Ops kickoff (Karthik + BrightCart infra) 30m after signature; 3) 48-hour activation window once kickoff completes.
